name: Code browser
tagline: File tree, file view, blame and code search
summary: Browse a repository at any branch, tag or commit: a file tree, folder listings, a file view with syntax colours, blame, a fuzzy file finder and code search.

flow.label: Code routes
flow.note: tree, blob and blame routes prefetch the tree, file and blame for the URL without blocking.

flow.label: useCodeLocation
flow.note: Splits the URL into ref and path from cached branch and tag names; asks the server if unsure.

flow.label: getRepoGitTree
flow.note: Fetches the whole tree for the ref in one recursive call and reports if GitHub truncated it.

flow.label: GitHub REST and GraphQL
flow.note: Git trees, contents (files up to 1 MB), commits and code search over REST; blame over GraphQL.

flow.label: Tree index
flow.note: Groups tree entries by folder once per tree; feeds folder listings, the sidebar and the finder.

flow.label: RepoExplorerLayout
flow.note: Resizable tree sidebar beside the folder, file or blame view; a drawer and action bar on phones.

features.name: File tree sidebar
features.summary: A @pierre/trees tree that selects and reveals the current path, and lists folders one by one when GitHub truncates the full tree.

features.name: Folder view
features.summary: Folder rows with file-type icons and each entry's last commit, fetched for the whole folder in one aliased GraphQL query.

features.name: File view
features.summary: Text with line numbers and Shiki colours, Markdown and SVG preview, image preview, and plain states for binary, too-large, submodule and missing files.

features.name: Line links and permalinks
features.summary: Click or shift-click line numbers to put #L10-L20 in the URL. Y copies a link pinned to the commit SHA instead of the branch.

features.name: Blame view
features.summary: Shows which commit last touched each range of lines, with links to that commit and to the file as it was before it.

features.name: Go to file
features.summary: Press T for a fuzzy finder over every path in the cached tree. It can pass the typed text on to code search.

features.name: Code search
features.summary: Searches one repo through GitHub code search with highlighted fragments, matching paths from the tree, paging and a rate-limit state.
